name: Otter
oneLiner: Restaurant technology for delivery-heavy operators: aggregates orders from Uber Eats, DoorDash, Grubhub and direct channels into one queue, with menu management, POS, kiosk, online and QR ordering, and sales reporting across channels.
bestFor: Restaurants, multi-brand and virtual kitchens with a large share of third-party delivery orders that want one tablet, one menu and one report across channels.

updates.text: Added a DoorDash plugin so staff can track Dashers and contact customers from the orders screen.
Named one of the inaugural partners in DoorDash's Preferred Integrations Program, announced at the National Restaurant Association Show.
Added per-channel notification controls (POS, delivery apps, direct ordering).

features: One order queue for Uber Eats, DoorDash, Grubhub and direct orders
Central menu management pushed to every delivery platform
Pause stores and mark items unavailable across channels (including from the Otter Go mobile app)
Sales, menu-item and channel reporting across platforms
Own POS, kiosk, online ordering and QR ordering
Delivery integrations such as DoorDash courier tracking

pricing.text: Custom pricing; Otter does not publish a public price list (third-party sites describe tiered plans with add-ons).

notes: IMPORTANT: no product called 'Otter Pulse' could be found on tryotter.com or in search results. The current review describes a guest-feedback/NPS/CSAT survey platform (QR/SMS/email surveys, sentiment analysis), which does not match Otter, a delivery order-management and POS company. All of the review's feature claims about feedback collection, NPS/CSAT and reservation integrations are dropped. Otter's analytics are sales/channel reporting, so it fits a restaurant analytics list only as a delivery-sales analytics tool. Other customers named in Otter press (Business Wire, early 2025): Skyline Chili (middleware, Jan 2025) and Catapult (Feb 2025); source URLs not captured this session. A trade site reports September 2026 updates (photo assignment, AI menu descriptions, discounts, Uber Eats busy-mode sync), not confirmed from Otter itself. Search budget ran out before 2026 Otter announcements could be checked further. Do not confuse with Otter.ai (meeting transcription).
